text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan celebrates independence day on Sunday. King Hussein congratulated by world leaders.
- King, Egypt's President Mubarak reaffirm need to revive Middle East peace process without delay. King says no room for despair.
- Central Bank Governor Fariz says economy expected to grow by more than six percent in 1997, national debt should fall as result of economic reforms.
- King says he hopes U.S. will play more positive role in Middle East peace process.
- Trade, Industry and Supply Minister Mulqi says Jordan, Egypt at meeting in Cairo will discuss setting up free trade zone.
- Parliamentary speaker Srour says there was consensus among MPs that press law needed to be amended.
- Heads of lawyers', engineers', dentists' and writers' unions resign in protest at amended press law.
- New progressive alliance promises birth of fourth major political party.
